acquisition_method: Data analysis was conducted using Spectronaut software (version 18.5.231110.55695) in directDIA mode.
instrument: The peptide mixtures were analyzed using an Exploris 480 MS.
ionization_type: The proteome of the samples was characterized by nano-liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) analysis.
labeling: inferred: Protein abundances between samples were then compared using statistical tests to determine differential abundance.
mass_analyzer: inferred: The peptide mixtures were analyzed using an Exploris 480 MS.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine, oxidation of methionine and acetylation of protein N-termini
Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as a fixed modification, while oxidation of methionine and acetylation of protein N-termini were set as variable modifications.
